name: [UPDATE 2.8] Chainsaw Man Incremental
desc:
Become the Ultimate Devil Hunter.

  Train, slay devils, and evolve from a rookie Public Safety hunter into an unstoppable force in this Chainsaw
  Man-inspired Incremental RPG.

  Start small… then break the system.

  🔥 WHAT YOU DO

  Train to build raw power and devil-slaying strength

  Unlock devil contracts and awaken devastating abilities

  Hunt devils through missions and story arcs

  Roll legendary traits and fighting styles

  Defeat boss devils and collect permanent drops

  Climb global leaderboards and prove you're built different

  ⚡ CORE FEATURES

  Infinite progression — no caps, only growth

  7 story arcs including full-scale devil invasions

  Contract & Trait gacha system

  Boss raids with rare devil drops

  Visible power progression and rank upgrades

  👑 You start at the bottom of Public Safety.
  You claw your way to the top.
